reviewer: lead editor, not the Spanish theory writer
method: The Chinese eight-essay source was read in full. Frozen Spanish drafts are then read in full, in order, against those sources; unit counts are navigation aids, not evidence of prose quality. Findings are held separately until the writer finishes to avoid concurrent overwrites.

issues.before: el estándar del agua de una provincia
issues.after: el estándar de abastecimiento de agua de un estado
issues.reason: Chinese says a state's water-use standard; align the state level with the fictional setting and make the supply standard explicit rather than sounding like an unspecified water-quality standard.

issues.before: La demora en autorizar uno nuevo corresponde a las autoridades estatales que tramitan el permiso.
issues.after: La demora en autorizar uno nuevo también exige pedir explicaciones a las autoridades estatales que tramitan el permiso.
issues.reason: Source says to question the approval office; do not turn identification of the accountable address into a finding of causal fault.

issues.before: uno de los antiguos pozos había registrado realmente un exceso bacteriano
issues.after: se había registrado una vez un exceso bacteriano en el agua de los antiguos pozos
issues.reason: Source supplies one historical exceedance, not a finding that identifies a single specific well.
